meta.title: Find a Home in Da Nang | Green Basket Concierge
meta.description: Property search by your criteria, online viewings with a local specialist, and support with communication and the rental process in Da Nang.

hero.title: Find a home in Da Nang without endless chats or blind trips
hero.description: We shortlist homes from our database and open sources to match your criteria. A local specialist visits the property, walks you through it online with a checklist, and helps coordinate conversations with the local side — through one point of contact.
hero.imageAlt: Illustrative apartment interior in Da Nang during a home inspection
hero.photoCaption: We check first — you decide next
